---
title: "Summarize flumut output"
output: github_document
date: "2025-04-21"
---

# Objectives:
* read in multiple batches output of flumut: mutations, markers, literature. Merge across batches.
* parse the mutation from the subtype
* lookup the subtype in the metadata. Filter mutations based on matching
* output missing or suspect subtype
* summarize the mutations as frequency across positions
* count unique mutation by type/effect, segment

## Changes in v10 (2026-10), ported from wildlife summarize-muts_202609.Rmd
* read flumut tsv as character: columns with only "T" or "F" were parsed as logical TRUE/FALSE (threonine/phenylalanine), now converted back to the amino acid
* drop redundant inverse PB2.K627E (keep E627K)
* marker effects joined per mutation: all effects collapsed with ";" (effect_multi) and first effect (effect_first, single-mutation markers preferred)
* markers deduplicated on marker+effect (not marker only, which dropped ~half of the effects)
* mammal and drug-resistance flags from effect text (fixes "oseltamavir" typo; covers all neuraminidase inhibitors, adamantanes, baloxavir, favipiravir)
* bar plots with effect text, for all mutations and for mammal/drug-related mutations
* ambiguous residues (mixtures) are their own type; residue plots: all residues, NonWildResidue (prim+sec+mixture), PrimaryResidue
* per-protein plots in figures/{PROT}/ subfolders

## to do
* calculate shannon diversity, entropy, ... by position
* connect to existing metadata for downstream modelling (mutation of interest presence/absence as covariates)

# Read and clean data
## read and merge flumut mutations, markers, literature
```{r  warning=FALSE }
#lists with element for each batch number
mut<-mark<-lit<-meta<-replicate(n=n.b, vector())

# Read across batches - ignore warnings (empty rows for some cols)
for (i in 1:n.b){
  #as character, otherwise a column of only T or F residues is read as logical TRUE/FALSE
  #na.strings="" so an N/A mixture residue "NA" isn't read as missing
  mut[[i]]<-read.delim(mut.in[i], colClasses = "character", na.strings = "")

  lit[[i]]<-read.delim(lit.in[i])  #not all cols have names
  mark[[i]]<-read.delim(mark.in[i]) #need to process further
  
  meta[[i]]<-read.csv(meta.in[i], header = T)
  meta[[i]]$date_parse<-as.character(meta[[i]]$date_parse)
}

# Merge across batches
mut.all<-bind_rows(mut)
#all mutations reported by flumut (union of batch columns), for counts by protein
flumut.muts<-setdiff(colnames(mut.all), "Sample") %>% str_replace_all("PB1.F2", "PB1-F2")
length(flumut.muts) #300
meta.all<-bind_rows(meta)

#get rid of nonsense cols
meta.all<-meta.all %>% select(-any_of(c("X.3","X.2", "X.1", "X")))
colnames(meta.all) #seq_newflu was designated for sequence names

rm(meta)
rm(mut)
```

## Marker effects per mutation (mammal and drug flags)
```{r}
#effect text patterns (lowercase); "2[-–]6" catches both hyphen and en dash in flumut text
mamm.pattern<-"human|mammal|ferret|cattle|swine|guinea|mice|2[-–]6"
#"amivir" = oseltamivir, zanamivir, peramivir, laninamivir; "zanamiriv" and "amantidine" are typos in flumut db
drug.pattern<-"amivir|zanamiriv|baloxavir|favipiravir|amantadine|amantidine|rimantadine"

#split combination markers into single mutations, convert to mutation col names (e.g. "HA1-5:S107R" -> "HA1.5.S107R")
mark.all.long<-mark.all %>%
  mutate(marker_full=Marker,
         combo=str_detect(Marker, ",")) %>%
  separate_rows(Marker, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(mutation=str_replace_all(Marker, "\\:|-", ".") %>%
           str_replace_all("PB1.F2", "PB1-F2"))

#one row per mutation: all effects (;) and first effect, single-mutation markers first
mut.effects<-mark.all.long %>%
  arrange(combo) %>%
  group_by(mutation) %>%
  summarise(effect_multi=paste(unique(Effect), collapse = "; "),
            effect_first=first(Effect),
            n_effects=n_distinct(Effect),
            combo_only=all(combo),
            markers=paste(unique(marker_full), collapse = " | "),
            mammal=any(str_detect(tolower(Effect), mamm.pattern)),
            drug=any(str_detect(tolower(Effect), drug.pattern)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(marker_class=case_when(mammal & drug ~ "mammal+drug",
                                mammal ~ "mammal",
                                drug ~ "drug",
                                TRUE ~ "other"))
table(mut.effects$marker_class)

#CHECK effects not flagged as mammal or drug - scan for anything missed
mark.all %>%
  filter(!str_detect(tolower(Effect), paste(mamm.pattern, drug.pattern, sep = "|"))) %>%
  distinct(Effect) %>% arrange(Effect)

write.csv(mut.effects, mut.effect.out, row.names = F)
rm(mark.all)
```

## separate/parse the protein, mutation, subtype
```{r, message=FALSE}
#separate mutation string
#replace this with -
muts.all.long$mutation[str_which(muts.all.long$mutation,"PB1.F2")]
muts.all.long$mutation<-str_replace_all(muts.all.long$mutation, "PB1.F2", "PB1-F2")

# Convert to data.table if not already
muts.all.long2<-muts.all.long
setDT(muts.all.long2)

# Split into 3 columns, filling from the left (so subtype ends up in the middle)
muts.all.long2[, c("part1", "part2", "part3") := tstrsplit(mutation, "\\.", fixed = FALSE, fill = "")]

# Use logic to assign proper columns
muts.all.long2[, `:=`(
  protein = ifelse(part3 == "", part1, part1),
  sub = ifelse(part3 == "", NA_character_, part2),
  mut = ifelse(part3 == "", part2, part3)
)]

# Drop temporary columns
muts.all.long2[, c("part1", "part2", "part3") := NULL]
table(muts.all.long2$protein)

# muts.all.long2$protein %>% table
# muts.all.long2$sub %>% table # these are muts where subtypes are 1:5 (HA and NA types) and otherwise empty
# muts.all.long2$mut %>% table # missing mut where it's subtype


# Extract mutation parts from mut (e.g., "A123T")
muts.all.long2[, mut.wt := str_sub(mut, 1, 1)]
muts.all.long2[, mut.mut := str_sub(mut, -1)]
muts.all.long2[, mut.pos := as.numeric(str_sub(mut, 2, -2))]

# Assign mutation type based on comparison
muts.all.long2[, type := fifelse(residue == mut.wt, "wild",
                          fifelse(residue == mut.mut, "mut_prim", "mut_sec"))]

#Check summary
table(muts.all.long2$type)
```

## Deal with residue==TRUE/FALSE and redundant inverse mutation
```{r}
#should be none now that tsv is read as character; v2.1 had 5000 TRUE (PA.S515T, PB2.V598T)
#TRUE/FALSE are the amino acids T (threonine) and F (phenylalanine), not present/absent
tf<-which(muts.all.long2$residue %in% c("TRUE","FALSE"))
length(tf)
if(length(tf)>0){
  muts.all.long2[tf, residue := fifelse(residue == "TRUE", "T", "F")]
  muts.all.long2[tf, type := fifelse(residue == mut.wt, "wild",
                                fifelse(residue == mut.mut, "mut_prim", "mut_sec"))]
}

#inverse pairs (same position, wt and mut swapped)
inv<-unique(muts.all.long2[, .(protein, mutation, mut.pos, mut.wt, mut.mut)])
merge(inv, inv, by.x=c("protein","mut.pos","mut.wt","mut.mut"),
      by.y=c("protein","mut.pos","mut.mut","mut.wt"))

## redundant: keep E627K remove K627E
muts.all.long2<-muts.all.long2[mutation != "PB2.K627E"]
table(muts.all.long2$mutation[muts.all.long2$protein=="PB2"])

#CHECK all marker mutations match mutation cols (K627E only in a combo marker)
setdiff(mut.effects$mutation, unique(muts.all.long2$mutation))
```

## order mutations within proteins for viz
```{r}
#Join protein to segment
prot.seg<-read.csv(prot.segment.look, header=T)
prot.seg<-prot.seg[,-1] #poubelle

#Make sure not interpreted as NA
if(any(is.na(prot.seg$protein.name))){
  na.prot<-which(is.na(prot.seg$protein.name))
  na.seg<-which(is.na(prot.seg$segment))
  if(length(na.prot)>0){prot.seg$protein.name[na.prot]<-"NA"}
  if(length(na.seg)>0){prot.seg$segment[na.seg]<-"NA"}
}

#all have matchs in lookup?
all(muts.all.long2$protein %in% prot.seg$protein.name)
# prot.seg$segment<-str_replace_all(prot.seg$segment, c("M"="MP"))
colnames(prot.seg)[1]<-"protein"
muts.all.long2<-muts.all.long2 %>% left_join (prot.seg, by="protein")
# table(muts.all.long2$segment)
#order for factors
# protein.ord<-prot.seg$protein[which(prot.seg$protein %in% muts.all.long2$protein)]
# protein.ord #this order isn't good
protein.ord<-c("PB2","PB1","PB1-F2","PA","NP","HA1","HA2","NA","M1","M2","NS")
n.prot<-length(protein.ord)
muts.all.long2$protein<-factor(muts.all.long2$protein, levels=protein.ord)
muts.all.long2$segment<-factor(muts.all.long2$segment, levels=segments)

#mutation order for each protein
ords<-replicate(n=n.prot, vector())
for (i in 1:n.prot){
  ords[[i]]<-muts.all.long2 %>%
    filter(protein == protein.ord[i]) %>%
    arrange(mut.pos) %>%
    select(mut) %>% unique()
  ords[[i]]$protein<-protein.ord[i]
  ords[[i]]<-ords[[i]] %>% left_join (prot.seg, by="protein")
  ords[[i]]$segment<-factor(ords[[i]]$segment, levels = segments)
  ords[[i]]$protein<-factor(ords[[i]]$protein, levels = protein.ord)
}
ords.df<-bind_rows(ords)
mut.ords<-ords.df$mut

#protein version - before renaming dups, otherwise e.g. NS:V149A becomes NS:NS_V149A and is NA in the data
ords.df<-ords.df %>% unite("protmut", protein, mut, sep=":",remove = F)
protmut.ords<-ords.df$protmut

if(any(duplicated(mut.ords))){
  dup<-which(duplicated(mut.ords))
  #add the protein on to the dup, have to be unique
  ords.df$mut[dup]<-paste0(ords.df$protein[dup],"_", ords.df$mut[dup])
  mut.ords<-ords.df$mut
}
muts.all.long2$mut<-factor(muts.all.long2$mut, levels=mut.ords)

## per-protein figure subfolders
walk(protein.ord, \(prot){
  d<-file.path(fig.out, prot)
  if(!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d)
})
```

## Bar plots with marker effects text
```{r}
#non-wild counts per mutation with one effect label per bar
effect_counts<-function(dat, keep){
  dat %>%
    filter(protmut %in% keep) %>%
    filter(! type %in% "wild") %>% #dont include wildtype residues
    filter(!is.na(protmut)) %>%
    count(protmut, protein, segment, mutation) %>%
    left_join(mut.effects, by="mutation")
}

#lab = "effect_multi" or "effect_first"; flip = one column (horizontal bars and text) instead of one row
plot_effect<-function(cnt, lab, flip=FALSE){
  if(!flip){
    cnt %>%
      ggplot(aes(x=protmut, y=n))+
      geom_col(aes(fill=segment))+
      geom_text(aes(label=.data[[lab]], y=0), angle=90, size=2.5, hjust=0, na.rm=TRUE)+
      plot.theme.date+
      labs(x="Mutation",y="Count")+
      scale_fill_manual(values=segment.cols)+
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=6),
            legend.position = "top")+
      guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1))
  } else {
    cnt %>%
      ggplot(aes(y=protmut, x=n))+
      geom_col(aes(fill=segment))+
      geom_text(aes(label=.data[[lab]], x=0), size=2.5, hjust=0, na.rm=TRUE)+
      plot.theme.date+
      labs(y="Mutation",x="Count")+
      scale_y_discrete(limits=rev)+ #PB2 at top
      scale_fill_manual(values=segment.cols)+
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=6),
            legend.position = "top")+
      guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1))
  }
}

#save one-row and one-column versions for multi and first effect labels
save_effect_plots<-function(cnt, prefix, suffix=""){
  nb<-nrow(cnt)
  for (lab in c("effect_multi","effect_first")){
    lab.nm<-str_replace(lab, "effect_", "effect")
    ggsave(paste0(fig.out, prefix, "_onerow_", lab.nm, suffix, ".png"),
           plot=plot_effect(cnt, lab),
           width = max(6, nb*0.15+2), height=7, units = "in")
    #width from longest label so multi-effect text isn't clipped (~0.045 in per char at size 2.5)
    lab.w<-max(nchar(cnt[[lab]]), 0, na.rm=TRUE)
    ggsave(paste0(fig.out, prefix, "_onecol_", lab.nm, suffix, ".png"),
           plot=plot_effect(cnt, lab, flip=TRUE),
           width = min(24, max(8, lab.w*0.045+3)), height=max(4, nb*0.15+2), units = "in")
  }
}

#all mutations, most frequent (n>1000 non-wild, as above)
```

## Count unique mutations by protein
```{r}
#protein from mutation col name, NS split into NS1/NS2 (e.g. "NS.1.P3S" -> NS1, "HA1.5.S107R" -> HA1)
mut_to_prot<-function(mutation){
  prot<-str_extract(mutation, "^[^.]+")
  sub<-str_match(mutation, "^[^.]+\\.(\\d+)\\.")[,2]
  ifelse(prot == "NS", paste0("NS", sub), prot)
}
prot.ns.ord<-c("PB2","PB1","PB1-F2","PA","NP","HA1","HA2","NA","M1","M2","NS1","NS2")

called.muts<-unique(muts.all.long2$mutation)
mut.counts<-tibble(mutation=flumut.muts) %>%
  mutate(protein=mut_to_prot(mutation),
         called=mutation %in% called.muts, #excludes dropped K627E and never-called
         mamm_drug=called & mutation %in% mamm.drug.mut) %>%
  group_by(protein) %>%
  summarise(n_flumut=n(),
            n_called=sum(called),
            n_mamm_drug=sum(mamm_drug),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(protein=factor(protein, levels=prot.ns.ord)) %>%
  arrange(protein) %>%
  mutate(protein=as.character(protein))
mut.counts<-mut.counts %>%
  bind_rows(mut.counts %>% summarise(across(starts_with("n_"), sum)) %>% mutate(protein="Total"))
mut.counts

write.csv(mut.counts, paste0(f.out, "mut_counts_by_protein.csv"), row.names = F)
```

## Plots of residues across mutations
```{r}
#residue plot per protein, saved to figures/{PROT}/
#types: residue = all incl wild, NonWildResidue = mut_prim+mut_sec+mixture, PrimaryResidue = mut_prim
plot_residue<-function(dat, prot, types, file.nm, xlab="Mutation of interest"){
  df<- dat %>%
    filter(protein == prot) %>%
    filter(type %in% types)
  ll<-length(unique(df$residue))
  #number of legend cols depends on n unique cats
  ncoll<-ceiling(ll/15) #20 rows max
  p<-df %>%
    ggplot()+
      geom_bar(aes(x=mut, group=residue, fill=residue), position = "stack")+
      plot.theme.date+
      labs(x=xlab,y="Count")+
      scale_fill_manual(values=amino.cols.all)+
      ggtitle(prot)+
    guides(fill=guide_legend(position = "right",ncol = ncoll, direction = "vertical",
                             override.aes = list(size=1)))
  mut.p<-ords.df %>%
    filter(protein == prot) %>% count() %>% as.numeric
  ww.p<-ceiling(sqrt(mut.p))+ncoll+1
  hh.p<-5
  ggsave(file.path(fig.out, prot, file.nm), plot=p, width = ww.p,height=hh.p,units = "in")
}

all.types<-c("wild","mut_prim","mut_sec","mixture")
for (i in 1:n.prot){
  prot<-protein.ord[i]
  plot_residue(muts.all.long2, prot, all.types,
               paste0("flumuts_",prot,"_residue.png"))
  plot_residue(muts.all.long2, prot, setdiff(all.types, "wild"),
               paste0("flumuts_",prot,"_NonWildResidue.png"))
  plot_residue(muts.all.long2, prot, "mut_prim",
               paste0("flumuts_",prot,"_PrimaryResidue.png"))
}
```

## Make wide by segment
```{r}
long_to_wide_seg<-function(dat) {
  mut.summ<-dat %>%
    unite(protein_mut, protein, mut, sep = ":", remove = FALSE) %>%
    select(sample, protein_mut, type, residue)
  # residue wide (if dups, keep unique values collapsed with ;)
  mut.summ2<-mut.summ %>%
    select(-type) %>%
    group_by(sample, protein_mut) %>%
    summarise(residue = paste(unique(residue), collapse = ";"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = protein_mut, values_from = residue)

  # type wide (same treatment)
  mut.summ3<-mut.summ %>%
    select(-residue) %>%
    group_by(sample, protein_mut) %>%
    summarise(type = paste(unique(type), collapse = ";"), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = protein_mut, values_from = type)
  colnames(mut.summ3)[-1]<-paste0(colnames(mut.summ3)[-1], "_type")
  left_join(mut.summ2, mut.summ3, by = "sample")
}

muts_wide_seg<-imap(muts_long_seg, ~ long_to_wide_seg(.x))
```

## Rename colnames with feature type and add a binarized set
```{r}
add_flumut_renames_and_bin <- function(wide_df) {
  stopifnot("sample" %in% names(wide_df))
  nm <- names(wide_df)
  type_cols_old <- nm[str_detect(nm, "(_type$|type$)")]
  res_cols_old  <- setdiff(nm, c("sample", type_cols_old))
  base_feat <- function(x) str_replace(x, "(_type$|type$)", "")
  # rename() wants: new = old  (names = new, values = old)
  res_map <- setNames(res_cols_old, paste0("flumut-res_", res_cols_old))
  type_map <- setNames(type_cols_old, paste0("flumut-type_", base_feat(type_cols_old)))

  out <- wide_df %>%
    rename(!!!res_map) %>%
    rename(!!!type_map)
  type_cols <- names(out)[startsWith(names(out), "flumut-type_")]
  out %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(type_cols),
        ~ case_when(
            is.na(.) ~ NA_integer_,
            . %in% c("mut_prim", "mut_sec", "mixture") ~ 1L, #mixture was mut_sec before v10, keep same binary
            . == "wild" ~ 0L,
            TRUE ~ NA_integer_
          ),
        .names = "flumut-bin_{str_replace(.col, '^flumut-type_', '')}"
      )
    )
}

muts_wide_seg2 <- imap(muts_wide_seg, ~ add_flumut_renames_and_bin(.x))
# colnames(muts_wide_seg2[["HA"]])
```
